purpose: Synthetic fixture vault plus end-to-end verification of the Ask My Brain retrieval core, which no test in this target had ever executed.
product_source_diff: none: src/ is byte-identical to the base
codex_rationale: None of the handoff's high-risk criteria are met: the package modifies no product source, handles no real data, performs no import/export, mutates no vault, touches no credentials, permissions, network or external API, and performs no schema/database/index migration or promotion behaviour. It adds deterministic tests and synthetic fixtures only. The owner may still require Codex at the merge gate.

defects_found_not_fixed.summary: chunk_note's cleanup regexes are written with doubled backslashes, so r"<!--[\\s\\S]*?-->" matches a character class of {backslash,s,S} rather than any character. HTML comments are therefore NOT stripped and pipeline metadata is indexed as retrieval evidence and shown to the model. The fence, separator and blank-line-collapse patterns carry the same defect.
defects_found_not_fixed.why_not_fixed: Repairing it changes chunking behaviour, which this package is explicitly forbidden to alter.

defects_found_not_fixed.summary: Content containing accented characters is indexed and matchable by FTS5, but unreachable through search(): query_terms uses r'[A-Za-z0-9]+' and the coverage reranker uses r'[^a-z0-9]+', so an accented word is shredded ('cafe resume pinata' accented -> ['caf','sum','pi','ata']; the ASCII spelling survives as ['cafe','resume','pinata'] but then never equals the accented body token). Both spellings return zero rows for content FTS5 can find.
defects_found_not_fixed.why_not_fixed: Repairing it changes retrieval/scoring behaviour, which this package is explicitly forbidden to alter.
defects_found_not_fixed.corrected_by: F3, in SB-ASK-003: the earlier wording attributed the shredding to the ASCII input.

defects_found_not_fixed.summary: A question made entirely of stopwords ('the') falls through query_terms' deliberate no-useful-terms fallback, matches as all_terms with coverage 1.0, and yields deterministic_evidence_strength == HIGH, so the model is called and the answer is labelled HIGH for a contentless question.
defects_found_not_fixed.why_not_fixed: The fallback is deliberate; changing it or the strength contract is a product policy decision, not an in-package repair.

defects_found_not_fixed.summary: A chunk's recorded line span can open AND close on the blank lines surrounding its text, so a printed citation range can be one line wide at each end. Found by strengthening the line-span assertion during repair 1.
defects_found_not_fixed.why_not_fixed: Repairing it changes chunking behaviour, which this package is forbidden to alter.

reproducers: evidence/SB-ASK-002-defect-reproducers.py (read-only, run from the repository root)
known_limitations: The suite pins exact fixture counts (13 notes, 11 indexed, 21 chunks, 2 skipped), exact chunk spans and exact row counts at the coverage boundary. Editing a fixture means updating them; that is intentional.

_path_within_vault cannot be reached from the suite: it guards resolve_scope's predicate, which only ever sees paths that came out of the index. Mutating it to return True survives. Declared rather than hidden.
bm25 field weights and the prefix-match minimum length are ranking internals nothing pins; mutating them survives.
Domain scoping is not exercised: it needs a domain-policy file this target does not hold. include_paths, exclude_paths and the policy errors are covered.
ask() is exercised end to end with ollama_chat stubbed; no model, and therefore no real answer text, is verified.
Incremental or changed-file rebuild, and behaviour against a missing or corrupt database, are untested.
check() exits on first failure, so one break masks later checkpoints. Acceptable for a gate; relevant when triaging.
